verdict.rationale: Portkey's AI Gateway explicitly documents load balancing to distribute traffic across multiple LLMs/providers by weight, plus fallbacks (priority-ordered failover on errors), gradual migration/canary rollout by percentage, and conditional routing to different targets — covering weight- and rule-based load balancing and resilience. However, explicit latency-based or cost-based automatic routing/load-balancing strategies are not documented, only weight-based distribution and cost tracking/budgets as separate features. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of latency-aware or cost-aware routing strategies (only weight-based load balancing and manual cost tracking are evidenced), and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
